280927280.description:
Sheaffer
Ferrari Official Licensed Product - Rosso Corsa Fountain Pen
2017 Production, Complete Gift Set
This Sheaffer Ferrari fountain pen represents a collaboration between the legendary Italian automaker and the historic American writing instrument manufacturer. Finished in the iconic Rosso Corsa red, the pen features the Scuderia Ferrari "Prancing Horse" shield on the clip and the Sheaffer White Dot of quality. Established in 1913, Sheaffer has long been synonymous with high-quality writing instruments, and their partnership with Ferrari brings a sporty, modern edge to their classic designs. This model reflects the sleek lines associated with Ferrari racing heritage, combined with Sheaffer's smooth-writing engineering.
Official Ferrari Licensed Product with holographic authentication seal (No. 240411816)
Rosso Corsa matte red finish with polished chrome appointments
Includes original Ferrari branded presentation box and outer sleeve
Two Sheaffer ink cartridges included (Blue and Black)
Sheaffer White Dot hallmark on clip alongside the Ferrari Shield
Condition:
Excellent condition, appears unused. The finish is pristine with no chips, scratches, or signs of wear. The clip is tight and aligned. Ink cartridges are sealed and included. Presentation box and outer sleeve show minimal storage wear.

Description
: Elevate your smoking accessories with this refined Decatur Industries pipe stand, featuring a genuine walnut wood base and matching lid. The set includes a clear, ribbed glass humidor jar, ideal for keeping pipe tobacco fresh, and provides dedicated slots to neatly hold up to four pipes, with two classic pipes included in this listing. One pipe has a rusticated, textured bowl with a dark finish and visible metal band, while the other showcases a smooth wood bowl and minimalist banding. The entire set displays mid-century craftsmanship and a timeless, organized look suitable for any collector or enthusiast's display. The wooden base is marked with an original Decatur Industries label, confirming the material as genuine walnut. All items show visible signs of previous use, such as light wear and a patina consistent with age, particularly on the pipes' stems and bowls. The glass jar is clean but may show minor interior markings from prior use. A classic piece that adds practicality and charm to any decor
